india.one_line: India signs AI supply pact, OpenAI appoints new lead, startups scale, and Meta adjusts Instagram AI.

themes.title: India joins AI supply chain pact
themes.text: India and nine other nations signed the San Francisco Declaration on the Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity to protect AI infrastructure and sensitive technologies on November 15.

stories.headline: India and nine nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains

themes.title: OpenAI appoints India business lead
themes.text: OpenAI named Pragya Misra, previously head of strategy and global affairs in India, to lead business development for India and South Asia; the company notes India is its largest market with over 100 million weekly users.

stories.headline: OpenAI names Pragya Misra to lead business development in India and South Asia

themes.title: Indian AI startups expand services
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, an OpenAI‑compatible API running large models on Indian GPU clusters, while Dreamteam raised $53 million to build an AI‑native CRM platform with AI teammates.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI opens Token Factory to run global open-weight models on Indian servers
Dreamteam raises $53m to build AI-native CRM with AI teammates

themes.title: Meta tweaks Instagram AI recommendations
themes.text: Meta updated Instagram’s recommendation systems in India to reduce sexually suggestive and violent content, using advanced AI models to filter Reels, Explore and Feed after regulatory scrutiny.

stories.headline: Meta modifies Instagram recommendation systems in India to curb violent content
